description:
Somos un equipo multidisciplinario, apasionado por la tecnología aplicada y la sostenibilidad del campo. Nuestro grupo integra experiencia técnica, científica y educativa para construir soluciones reales y automatizadas.

Nos motiva revolucionar la agricultura adaptándola a la crisis climática mediante la automatización y la inteligencia geoespacial. Queremos integrar los datos de observación de la Tierra de la NASA directamente con sistemas automatizados
summary: The proposed tool integrates farmers' ancestral and empirical knowledge with scientific Earth observation data provided by NASA to strengthen agricultural decision-making, optimize resources, and contribute to food security amid climate change impacts. Through an intuitive, accessible technological platform, it correlates climatic conditions, soil characteristics, and crop data with farmers' experiences and observations. Its analytical capabilities facilitate the interpretation of environmental variables, pattern identification, and selection of efficient strategies, such as crop rotation and territory-specific production adaptation. Its primary value lies in empowering farmers with reliable, comprehensible scientific information that complements and strengthens—rather than replaces—rural expertise, while bridging experienced generations with the learning needs of young producers for informed decisions. Uniting science, technology, and local knowledge, it stands as a strategic entry-level solution for farmers seeking to transform practices and face sector challenges with greater preparedness. Looking forward, the project aims to expand its analytical capabilities, incorporate new scientific and territorial data sources, and reach diverse rural communities to consolidate sustainable agriculture support, promote intergenerational knowledge transfer, and advance Sustainable Development Goal 2: Zero Hunger.
details:
General Description 

It is an interactive web platform that links the knowledge and experience of farmers with scientific Earth observation data provided by NASA. Its purpose is to bridge the digital and generational divide, facilitate the comprehension of environmental conditions, and assist farmers in making crop management decisions in response to climate change.

How It Works

 The platform aggregates climate, weather, and soil condition data alongside farmers' field observations and experiences. Through query and visualization tools, it enables a deeper understanding of terrain conditions, the detection of environmental shifts, and the exploration of crops best suited to each territory. Additionally, it facilitates the consultation of alternatives for crop selection and rotation based on the specific characteristics of each zone.

Key Benefits and Impact

  • Experienced Farmers: Complement their empirical knowledge with scientific data.
  • Young and Emerging Farmers: Gain a clearer understanding of the environmental variables influencing crop performance.
  • Rural Communities: Strengthen intergenerational knowledge exchange.
  • Agricultural Producers: Access actionable data to guide decision-making, optimize resources, and explore climate adaptation strategies.
  • Food Security: Contributes to a more sustainable and resilient agricultural sector, directly aligned with SDG 2: Zero Hunger.

Tools and Technologies The proposal incorporates the following technological tools and data sources:

  1. AGROSAT COLOMBIA 2.1 The core technological tool of the project. It consists of an interactive web platform that integrates, structures, and displays scientific data alongside farmer-contributed knowledge. Its function is to streamline the querying and interpretation of environmental variables within an accessible interface.
  2. NASA GIBS – MODIS and VIIRSPixel Perfect—GIBS and Worldview Help Lower Barriers for Users of NASA Earth Observing Data | NASA Earthdata A visualization service for georeferenced satellite imagery and data layers, enabling the inspection of land surface conditions and environmental phenomena.
  3. NASA POWERThe POWER of Earth Science Data | NASA Earthdata A meteorological and environmental data query service that provides climatic variables linked to specific geographic coordinates and timeframes.
  4. Open-Meteo ERA5-LandC3S releases first part of ERA5-Land dataset | ECMWF A terrestrial reanalysis data query service that supplies historical environmental variable datasets, including soil moisture profiles across multiple depths.

Creative Elements

  • Intergenerational Integration: Connects traditional farming expertise with the learning processes of new generations.
  • Accessible Science: Translates complex environmental datasets into comprehensible, actionable insights.
  • Complementary Knowledge: Merges traditional wisdom with scientific data without displacing either source.
  • Agricultural Analytics: Facilitates pattern recognition and the evaluation of crop diversification alternatives.
  • Sustainable Approach: Prioritizes climate change adaptation and long-term soil conservation.

USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) Artificial intelligence tools are utilized to support research activities, visual content creation, and technological development within the organization:

  • ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini: Used to research various topics, query information, summarize sources, and answer technical questions.
  • ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini: Used to generate visual assets for design and communication initiatives.
  • ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini: Used to assist in programming AgroSat, including code generation and review throughout the project's development lifecycle.

These tools serve as operational support across processes according to the specific requirements of each task. Artificial intelligence streamlines research, design, and software engineering workflows, while the human team directs the work and defines the target outcomes.
